identity.manufacturer_reference: Mercedes-Benz OM 471.9, power code M3D (engine series 471.9 in model 963/964)
identity.disclaimer: Public-spec reference simulation built from published service-literature figures. Not an OEM calibration, not a digital twin, and not endorsed by Mercedes-Benz. Manufacturer and engine names are used as factual references only. Values marked calibrated are our estimates, not OEM data.

sources.title: Introduction of engine OM 471 and exhaust aftertreatment
sources.scope: Engine series 471.9 in model 963/964. M3D power code, and documented M5Z Euro VI subsystems where explicitly stated. Later 390 kW / 2600 Nm / 2700 bar OM 471 figures are NOT part of this configuration.

provenance.value_note: 1-5-3-6-2-4, the conventional inline-six sequence. The source manual does NOT publish the OM 471 firing order.
provenance.purpose: Even 120-degree firing spacing for a six-cylinder four-stroke engine, so cylinder phase offsets are data-driven rather than hard-coded in the solver.

provenance.value_note: -2.7925 rad, i.e. 160 degrees before firing TDC (20 degrees after intake BDC). The manual publishes no valve events.
provenance.purpose: Boundary between the intake-manifold boundary condition and the closed compression period in the simplified Milestone 1 gas model.

provenance.value_note: 2.4435 rad, i.e. 140 degrees after firing TDC. The manual publishes no valve events.
provenance.purpose: Boundary between the closed expansion period and the exhaust-manifold boundary condition in the simplified Milestone 1 gas model.

provenance.value_note: 900 bar maximum rail pressure
provenance.locator: SN00.00-W-0002-05H, Technical data of diesel engine OM 471, printed page 11 (PDF page 14), Fuel system; also SN00.00-W-0002-04H, printed page 10 (PDF page 13)

provenance.value_note: APCRS injection pressure up to 2100 bar after local pressure amplification
provenance.locator: GF47.00-W-3013H, Fuel high pressure circuit function (471.9 in MODEL 963, code M5Z), printed page 100 (PDF page 103)

provenance.value_note: 42.7 MJ/kg, a general diesel-fuel reference figure. Not from the manual.
provenance.purpose: Converts latched fuel mass into released heat in the placeholder combustion model.

provenance.value_note: 230 mg per cylinder per cycle at full pedal. The manual publishes no fuelling map.
provenance.purpose: Upper bound on pedal fuel demand, before the air-limited smoke clip.

provenance.value_note: 22:1 minimum air/fuel ratio. The manual publishes no smoke limit.
provenance.purpose: Clips fuelling to the trapped air mass so that a naturally aspirated Milestone 1 engine cannot be fuelled past its air supply.

provenance.value_note: -0.0873 rad (5 degrees before firing TDC). Milestone 1 placeholder; there is no ignition-delay model.
provenance.purpose: Places the placeholder heat release so that pressure-derived torque is positive over the expansion stroke.

provenance.value_note: 0.6981 rad (40 degrees). Milestone 1 placeholder; no premixed/diffusion split.
provenance.purpose: Spreads the placeholder heat release so peak pressure stays well inside the 23 MPa envelope.

provenance.value_note: 0.98 of the fuel lower heating value released. Milestone 1 placeholder.
provenance.purpose: Accounts for incomplete combustion in the single-zone placeholder model.

provenance.value_note: 1150 J/(kg K) effective constant-volume specific heat for the heat-addition term. Milestone 1 placeholder.
provenance.purpose: Sets the temperature rise per unit of released heat; decoupled from the polytropic exponents so peak temperature stays physically plausible.

provenance.value_note: 1.35, below the ratio of specific heats to represent wall heat loss during compression. Milestone 1 placeholder.
provenance.purpose: Lumped compression heat transfer in place of an explicit wall heat-transfer model.

provenance.value_note: 1.30 during expansion. Milestone 1 placeholder.
provenance.purpose: Lumped expansion heat transfer in place of an explicit wall heat-transfer model.

provenance.value_note: 0.60 bar constant term. The manual publishes no friction map.
provenance.purpose: Speed-independent friction and pumping losses in the Chen-Flynn style FMEP model.

provenance.value_note: 0.005 of peak cylinder pressure. The manual publishes no friction map.
provenance.purpose: Load-dependent ring and bearing friction.

provenance.value_note: 1200 Pa per (m/s) of mean piston speed. The manual publishes no friction map.
provenance.purpose: Hydrodynamic friction proportional to piston speed.

provenance.value_note: 130 Pa per (m/s)^2 of mean piston speed. The manual publishes no friction map.
provenance.purpose: Windage and turbulent losses rising with the square of piston speed.

provenance.value_note: 101325 Pa. Milestone 1 runs naturally aspirated; the turbocharger and charge-air cooler arrive in Milestone 3.
provenance.purpose: Fixed intake boundary condition for the Milestone 1 gas-exchange model.

provenance.value_note: 320 K charge temperature. The manual publishes no charge-air temperature.
provenance.purpose: Fixed intake boundary condition, setting trapped air mass at intake valve closing.

provenance.value_note: 106000 Pa. The manual publishes no exhaust back-pressure figure.
provenance.purpose: Fixed exhaust boundary condition, producing the pumping-loss term explicitly.

provenance.value_note: 101325 Pa on the underside of the piston.
provenance.purpose: Back-pressure reference so crank torque uses the net gas force across the piston.

provenance.value_note: 287.0528 J/(kg K), the specific gas constant of dry air
0.92 trapping efficiency at intake valve closing. The manual publishes no breathing data.
provenance.purpose: Scales trapped air mass, which in turn sets the smoke-limited fuelling ceiling.

provenance.value_note: 560 rpm idle speed
provenance.locator: SN00.00-W-0002-05H, Technical data of diesel engine OM 471, printed page 11 (PDF page 14)

provenance.value_note: 1.2 mg per (rad/s) of speed error. The manual publishes no governor calibration.
provenance.purpose: Proportional term of the idle governor. Requests fuel, never torque.

provenance.value_note: 0.6 mg per (rad/s) per second of speed error. The manual publishes no governor calibration.
provenance.purpose: Integral term that holds the published 560 rpm idle against friction and accessory load.

provenance.value_note: 40 mg integrator clamp.
provenance.purpose: Prevents integral windup while cranking, which would otherwise overshoot idle badly.

provenance.value_note: 1900 rpm. The manual publishes neither the rated speed nor the governed speed.
provenance.purpose: Speed at which fuelling starts being withdrawn.

provenance.value_note: 2100 rpm. The manual publishes neither the rated speed nor the governed speed.
provenance.purpose: Speed at which fuelling reaches zero.

provenance.value_note: 25 N m constant accessory drag. The manual publishes no accessory loads.
provenance.purpose: Represents the fan, alternator, compressor and pumps as an explicit resisting term.

provenance.value_note: 0.02 N m per (rad/s). The manual publishes no accessory loads.
provenance.purpose: Speed-dependent part of the accessory drag.

provenance.value_note: 5000 N m ceiling for the user-supplied load control.
provenance.purpose: Bounds the external load input; real driveline behaviour arrives in Milestone 4.

provenance.value_note: 1500 N m stall torque at the crankshaft. The manual publishes no starter data.
provenance.purpose: Cranks the engine through compression until fuelling takes over.

provenance.value_note: 300 rpm. The manual publishes no starter data.
provenance.purpose: Speed at which starter torque reaches zero; also the threshold for the running state.

provenance.value_note: 3.5 kg m^2 for crankshaft, flywheel and rotating accessories. The manual publishes NO rotating inertia. The published complete-engine mass is deliberately not used here.
provenance.purpose: Sets crank acceleration for a given net torque.

provenance.value_note: approx. 1200 kg complete-engine weight. Metadata only: never used as flywheel or rotating inertia.
provenance.locator: SN00.00-W-0002-05H, Technical data of diesel engine OM 471, printed page 11 (PDF page 14)

provenance.value_note: combustion pressures of up to 230 bar; used here as a validation and safety envelope, not as a pressure target
provenance.locator: SN00.00-W-0002-04H, Engine OM 471, printed page 10 (PDF page 13)

provenance.value_note: 2400 rpm hard numerical guard, above the governed cut-out.
provenance.purpose: Rejects a diverged solution rather than letting crank speed run away.

provenance.value_note: 3000 K hard numerical guard.
provenance.purpose: Rejects a diverged single-zone gas state.

provenance.value_note: 25 microseconds, about 0.36 degrees of crank rotation at 2400 rpm.
provenance.purpose: Fixed integration step. Small enough that the explicit crank and gas integration stays stable across the whole speed range.

provenance.value_note: 20000 steps, i.e. 0.5 s of simulated time per advance call.
provenance.purpose: Keeps the WASM boundary coarse while bounding the work a single call can do.
